comments.body: :+1: to removing these. It will make many interactions much simpler!

Marking these features as @Deprecated is the first step. Complete removal of export/import can not occur until the following ticket has been resolved:
https://jira.duraspace.org/browse/FCREPO-1519
Shouldn't this result in the destruction of the fcrepo-serialization module?
Good. The more fcrepo code that is destroyed, the better.

Osman Din, please also update the wiki documentation:

  • https://wiki.duraspace.org/display/FEDORA4x/Feature+Tour+-+Action+-+Import
  • https://wiki.duraspace.org/display/FEDORA4x/RESTful+HTTP+API+-+Export+and+Import
Andrew Woods I have updated the documentation.
